    Samsung Memory is a comprehensive platform solutions provider accelerating the AI revolution. Understanding the unique challenges of AI, Samsung has developed an innovative product portfolio to address these challenges and meet all demands. HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) is optimized for high-performance computing, supporting fast training and inference through ultra-high-speed data processing. The CXL memory module maximizes system compatibility, while next-generation SSD solutions enable fast and secure storage of large volumes of data. Additionally, LPDDR and UFS deliver power efficiency and high-speed performance in mobile devices. Products & Technologies

DRAM

Breaking barriers in computing
Samsung’s DRAM drives innovation and accelerates performance in various computing solutions, from PCs to servers for advanced AI applications.
SSD

Setting the standard in storage
Samsung’s comprehensive SSD portfolio offers large capacities, high performance, and power efficiency in small form factors.
eStorage

Making the most of mobile storage
Samsung’s expertise in flash storage offers the freedom to design fashion-forward mobile devices that boast faster speed and better power efficiency.
MCP

Inspire design breakthroughs
By expertly combining mobile DRAM and NAND in a compact package, Samsung developed a full MCP lineup for cutting -edge performance and design
Automotive Memory

The invisible driving force
Beyond upgrades, a revolution. Samsung’s exceptional memory solutions for mobility are reshaping the automotive industry. In-vehicle Infotainment (IVI), Telematics Control Units (TCU), and Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) technology open up new mobility experiences, transforming how we work, play, and live.
